variantPolicy: Seeded variants alter event ordering, missing fields, and privacy flags; they are not independent published assets.

exercises.title: Specify a Privacy-Safe Commerce Event Contract
exercises.objective: Design a versioned event contract that supports diagnosis without exposing sensitive payloads.
exercises.initialState: A custom checkout extension emits free-text messages and a full request body on failures.
exercises.prompt: Define the event envelope, allowed dimensions, protected fields, redaction behavior, versioning rule, and unit/negative tests for checkout success, timeout, retry, and exception paths.
constraints: do not log credentials or payment payloads
separate request correlation from business reference
exercises.deliverable: Event schema, redaction table, and executable test plan.
acceptanceCriteria: schema version and outcome are explicit
correlation and business reference are distinct
sensitive fields are excluded or tokenized
normal and nested exception paths are tested

hints.text: Begin with the questions an operator must answer.
A business ID is not automatically safe as a trace key.

exercises.referenceSolution: Use a versioned JSON envelope with UTC event time, environment/aspect/service/operation/outcome, generated correlation/trace IDs, minimized business token, duration, error class and release. Exclude credentials and payloads; test serializer, redaction, retry, missing context, nested exception, and target-runtime forwarding.

exercises.title: Reconstruct a Delayed OpenSearch Timeline
exercises.objective: Investigate delayed and contradictory records without claiming causality from dashboard order.
exercises.initialState: A simulated bundle contains access, application, deployment, retry, and business-state records with event/ingestion delay.
exercises.prompt: Write and execute a bounded query plan, select control samples, construct the UTC timeline, rank hypotheses, and list evidence that would falsify the leading explanation.
constraints: do not use customer email as correlation
exercises.deliverable: Investigation record, timeline, hypothesis table, and verification plan.
acceptanceCriteria: event and ingestion time are distinguished
success and failure controls are included

hints.text: Start with impact and the smallest reliable time window.
An empty result has several possible explanations.

exercises.referenceSolution: Bound the environment and UTC window, identify tenant and documented origin/aspect filters, preserve event and ingestion times, choose representative control records, correlate by generated identifiers, and validate the business state separately from the request result.

exercises.title: Test a Defective Correlation Propagator
exercises.objective: Diagnose and correct context loss across retry, asynchronous processing, and failure paths.
exercises.initialState: A simulated logger preserves correlation on success but drops it on retry and emits an unredacted exception field after cancellation.
exercises.prompt: Create a test matrix and correction proposal covering synchronous request, retry, CronJob trigger, cancellation, duplicate execution, malformed event, and nested exception paths.
constraints: unit tests are not platform proof
assert no unsafe action is required
exercises.deliverable: Defect diagnosis, tests, correction, and evidence manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: each path has an observable assertion
retry and async context are covered
redaction is verified after exception wrapping

hints.text: Test the context at every boundary, not only at the controller.
Cancellation often takes a different exception path.

hardFailPhrases: the code compiles so it is done
unit test proves Cloud Portal forwarding

exercises.referenceSolution: Instrument a single safe context object, propagate a generated correlation/trace token through retry and async trigger, use a minimized business token, and assert normal, rejection, retry, cancellation, duplicate, malformed, and nested exception paths. Execute platform forwarding tests only in a configured target runtime and label local tests as simulation/unit evidence.
